# Non-Functional Requirements

Status: draft

## NFR-1: Rendering Performance

The game shall render at a target of 60 frames per second on a 2020-era laptop in Google Chrome during normal gameplay, including parallax starfield and combat effects.

## NFR-2: Offline Operation

The game shall operate fully offline with no external CDN dependencies and no network requests at runtime after the initial `npm install`.

## NFR-3: Language

All user-facing text in the game shall be in English.

## NFR-4: Unit Test Coverage

The project shall include unit tests covering market pricing logic, jump/fuel consumption math, combat resolution, and save/load serialization. Tests shall be runnable via `npm test`.

## NFR-5: Browser Smoke Test

The project shall include a browser smoke test that loads the game page and asserts that the canvas renders successfully. This test shall be runnable via a separate script.

## NFR-6: Zero Build Steps

The game shall be playable immediately after `npm install && npm start` with no manual build, bundle, or compilation step required by the user.
